title: Surface-code syndrome decoding improves logical qubit fidelity
summary: Syndrome-guided redundancy detects correlated errors before they accumulate into logical failures.
proposed_experiment: Benchmark adaptive syndrome-decoding policies against a correlated-noise baseline.

title: High-fidelity CRISPR screening reduces off-target edits
summary: Guide-quality filtering and repair-pathway selection reduce off-target mutation burden during editing.
proposed_experiment: Compare standard Cas9 editing against high-fidelity guide screening across matched cell lines.

title: DNA repair checkpoints use pre-commitment error sensing
summary: Checkpoint signaling can detect damage signatures before full repair commitment, improving genome stability.
proposed_experiment: Perturb checkpoint sensing and quantify the downstream effect on repair accuracy and genome stability.

title: Quantum-coherent control stabilizes noisy molecular trajectories
summary: Coherence-aware feedback can stabilize fragile molecular transitions that would otherwise drift under noise.
proposed_experiment: Measure whether coherence-aware feedback improves transition stability relative to open-loop control.
